regions.today: Mostly cloudy today with limited sunny spells and just a few patches of light rain or drizzle. Humid with highest temperatures 17 to 23, warmest in the southeast, with a light to moderate southwesterly breeze.
regions.tonight: Mild and humid tonight. Remaining mostly dry with a mix of cloud and some clear spells.Lowest temperatures of 14 to 18 degrees, with light to moderate southwest winds.
regions.tomorrow: Warm and humid today. Staying mostly dry with just the odd spot of light rain or drizzle possible. While it will be quite cloudy, sunny spells should improve as the day goes on. Highest temperatures of 20 to 25 degrees, with mostly moderate, occasionally fresh, southwesterly winds.
